original_title: Roblox Reveals 6 New Exclusive 18+ Games, Including an Extraction Shooter From the Co-Founder of Bungie
summary_en: Roblox is expanding its adult-oriented gaming offerings with six new exclusive titles, including a highly anticipated extraction shooter from a Bungie co-founder. This move signals a significant push to attract older players and experienced developers to the platform.
ai_analysis: This initiative highlights Roblox's strategic pivot towards more mature content and its ability to attract veteran game designers, potentially reshaping the platform's perception beyond its younger demographic.

en.title: Bungie Co-Founder's 18+ Extraction Shooter Drifters Coming to Roblox
en.summary: Roblox is expanding its adult-oriented gaming offerings with six new exclusive titles, including a highly anticipated extraction shooter from a Bungie co-founder. This move signals a significant push to attract older players and experienced developers to the platform.
en.body:
Roblox is making a bold statement in the gaming world, unveiling six exclusive 18+ titles that aim to capture the attention of a more mature audience. Among these new projects is **Drifters**, an ambitious extraction shooter spearheaded by **Alexander Seropian**, the co-founder of the legendary studio **Bungie**. This announcement comes as part of the **Roblox Incubator** program, a six-month initiative designed to nurture promising game concepts from established developers into polished experiences.

The **Roblox Incubator** program is clearly attracting top-tier talent. **Seropian**, now the founder and CEO of **Look North World**, has assembled a team comprised of veterans from **Bungie**, **Disney Interactive**, **EA**, and **Epic Games**. Their focus with **Drifters** is a perilous extraction shooter set in a world teeming with hostile AI and, more importantly, even more aggressive players. This is not **Seropian**'s first foray into the extraction shooter genre; **Bungie** itself is developing **Marathon**, a PvP-focused title slated for a March 5, 2026 release, which also aims to be one of the most exciting extraction shooters of that year.

## A New Frontier for Roblox

**Alexander Seropian** expressed his enthusiasm for developing on the **Roblox** platform, noting its vibrant energy and growth potential. He stated, "I spent my career trying to zig while others have zagged, always looking for new opportunities to learn and grow as a game developer, and my journey on Roblox so far has been the most exciting and personally rewarding since my early days making games on the PC." This sentiment underscores **Roblox**'s ambition to evolve beyond its perception as a platform solely for younger players, leveraging its powerful creation tools to support diverse and mature gaming experiences.

The six new games, though in the early stages of development, promise a wide array of genres and gameplay styles. While initial glimpses are limited to short clips and screenshots, the developers are clearly aiming for deep, fleshed-out experiences that can thrive within the unique ecosystem of **Roblox**. This strategic expansion into the 18+ market, coupled with support for seasoned developers, signifies a significant evolution for the platform, aiming to attract a broader player base and a wider range of creative talent.

## What This Means for Gamers

For fans of extraction shooters and mature-themed games, this news is incredibly exciting. The involvement of **Alexander Seropian**, a figure with such a rich history in game development, lends significant credibility to **Drifters**. The prospect of playing a polished, 18+ extraction shooter developed by a team with pedigree, all within the accessible **Roblox** framework, is a compelling proposition. This move by **Roblox** directly addresses the growing demand for more adult-oriented content on the platform and signals a commitment to pushing creative boundaries. It also suggests that **Roblox** is positioning itself as a serious contender in the broader gaming landscape, capable of hosting experiences that rival those on traditional consoles and PC.

## What's Next

These six new titles are currently in development as part of the **Roblox Incubator** program, with a target for their release in 2026. Further details on **Drifters** and the other 18+ exclusives are expected to emerge as development progresses.

tr.title: Bungie'nin Kurucu Ortağından 18+ Extraction Shooter Drifters Roblox'a Geliyor
tr.summary: Roblox, altı yeni 18+ oyun ile yetişkinlere yönelik oyun tekliflerini genişletiyor. Bungie'nin kurucu ortağı Alexander Seropian'ın öncülük ettiği Drifters, bu yeni oyunlardan biri. Bu hamle, platformun daha yaşlı oyuncuları ve deneyimli geliştiricileri çekme konusundaki önemli bir adımını gösteriyor.
tr.body:
## Roblox'un Yeni Adımı
Roblox, altı yeni 18+ oyun ile yetişkinlere yönelik oyun tekliflerini genişletiyor. Bu yeni oyunlardan biri, Bungie'nin kurucu ortağı **Alexander Seropian** tarafından geliştirilen **Drifters** adlı extraction shooter. Bu oyun, **Roblox Incubator** programı kapsamında geliştiriliyor. Bu program, altı aylık bir süre boyunca deneyimli geliştiricilerin oyun kavramlarını tamamlanmış deneyimlere dönüştürmeyi amaçlıyor.

**Roblox Incubator** programı, üst düzey yeteneği çekmeyi başardı. **Seropian**, şimdi **Look North World**'ün kurucusu ve CEO'su, **Bungie**, **Disney Interactive**, **EA** ve **Epic Games**'ten deneyimli bir ekip kurdu. **Drifters** ile odaklandıkları, düşman AI'lerle dolu bir dünyada oynanan tehlikeli bir extraction shooter. Bu, **Seropian**'in extraction shooter türündeki ilk denemesi değil; **Bungie** itself, **Marathon** adlı bir PvP odaklı oyun geliştiriyor ve bu oyun, 5 Mart 2026'da piyasaya sürülecek.

## Roblox için Yeni Bir Dönem
**Alexander Seropian**, Roblox platformunda geliştirme yapmaktan heyecan duyduğunu belirtti ve platformun canlı enerjisi ve büyüme potansiyelini vurguladı. "Kariyerim boyunca diğerlerinin zig yaptığı yerde zag yapmaya çalıştım, luôn yeni öğrenme ve büyüme fırsatları aradım ve Roblox'ta geçirdiğim süre, PC'de oyun yapmayı başladığım günlerden bu yana en heyecan verici ve kişisel olarak en ödüllü deneyim oldu" dedi. Bu, Roblox'un yalnızca genç oyunculara yönelik bir platform olarak algılanmasının ötesine geçme amacını vurguluyor ve güçlü création araçlarını kullanarak çeşitli ve olgun oyun deneyimlerini desteklemeyi amaçlıyor.

Altı yeni oyun, geliştirme aşamasının başlarında olsa da, geniş bir yelpazede tür ve oyun stilini vaat ediyor. İlk bakışlar kısa klipler ve ekran görüntülerine sınırlı olsa da, geliştiriciler açıkça **Roblox**'un benzersiz ekosisteminde gelişebilecek derin ve etraflıca düşünülmüş deneyimler yaratmaya çalışıyor. 18+ pazarına yönelik bu stratejik genişleme, deneyimli geliştiricilere destek ile birleşerek platform için önemli bir evrimi gösteriyor ve daha geniş bir oyuncu kitlesini ve daha çeşitli yaratıcı yeteneği çekmeyi amaçlıyor.

## Oyuncular için Ne Anlama Geliyor
Extraction shooter ve olgun temalı oyun severleri için bu haber son derece heyecan verici. **Alexander Seropian**'in katılımı, **Drifters**'e önemli bir kredi kazandırıyor. Bir extraction shooter oynama olasılığı, özellikle de 18+ ve **Roblox**'un erişilebilir çerçevesi içinde, çekici bir teklif sunuyor. Roblox'un bu adımı, platforma yönelik daha yetişkin içerik talebini doğrudan ele alıyor ve yaratıcı sınırları zorlama taahhüdünü gösteriyor. Ayrıca, Roblox'un geleneksel konsollar ve PC'de bulunan deneyimleri ile rekabet edebilecek bir oyun ortamı sunma konusundaki ciddi bir rakip olarak konumlandığını gösteriyor.

## Sonraki Adımlar
Bu altı yeni oyun, **Roblox Incubator** programı kapsamında geliştiriliyor ve 2026'da piyasaya sürülmesi hedefleniyor. **Drifters** ve diğer 18+ özel oyunlar hakkında daha fazla ayrıntı, geliştirme ilerledikçe ortaya çıkacak.

es.title: Bungie Co-Fundador Lleva su Disparador de Extracción 18+ Drifters a Roblox
es.summary: Roblox expande su oferta de juegos orientados a adultos con seis nuevos títulos exclusivos, incluyendo el esperado disparador de extracción Drifters de Alexander Seropian, co-fundador de Bungie. Esta movida señala un importante esfuerzo por atraer a jugadores mayores y desarrolladores experimentados a la plataforma.
es.body:
Roblox está haciendo una declaración audaz en el mundo de los videojuegos, presentando seis títulos exclusivos para mayores de 18 años que buscan capturar la atención de una audiencia más madura. Entre estos nuevos proyectos se encuentra **Drifters**, un ambicioso disparador de extracción liderado por **Alexander Seropian**, co-fundador del legendario estudio **Bungie**. Este anuncio llega como parte del programa **Roblox Incubator**, una iniciativa de seis meses diseñada para nutrir conceptos de juegos prometedores de desarrolladores establecidos y convertirlos en experiencias pulidas.

## Un Nuevo Frente para Roblox

**Alexander Seropian** ha expresado su entusiasmo por desarrollar en la plataforma **Roblox**, destacando su vibrante energía y potencial de crecimiento. Ha declarado: > "He pasado mi carrera tratando de innovar mientras otros seguían el camino tradicional, siempre buscando nuevas oportunidades para aprender y crecer como desarrollador de juegos, y mi experiencia en Roblox hasta ahora ha sido la más emocionante y personalmente gratificante desde mis primeros días haciendo juegos en PC". Esto subraya la ambición de **Roblox** de evolucionar más allá de su percepción como una plataforma solo para jugadores más jóvenes, aprovechando sus poderosas herramientas de creación para apoyar experiencias de juego diversas y maduras.

Los seis nuevos juegos, aunque en etapas tempranas de desarrollo, prometen una amplia variedad de géneros y estilos de juego. Aunque las primeras vistas se limitan a clips cortos y capturas de pantalla, los desarrolladores claramente apuntan a experiencias profundas y bien desarrolladas que puedan prosperar dentro del ecosistema único de **Roblox**. Esta expansión estratégica en el mercado de 18+ años, combinada con el apoyo a desarrolladores experimentados, señala una evolución significativa para la plataforma, buscando atraer a una base de jugadores más amplia y una gama más amplia de talento creativo.

## Qué Significa Esto para los Jugadores

Para los fanáticos de los disparadores de extracción y los juegos con temas maduros, esta noticia es increíblemente emocionante. La participación de **Alexander Seropian**, una figura con una rica historia en el desarrollo de juegos, le da una gran credibilidad a **Drifters**. La perspectiva de jugar un disparador de extracción pulido y para mayores de 18 años, desarrollado por un equipo con pedigrí, todo dentro del marco accesible de **Roblox**, es una propuesta muy atractiva. Esta movida de **Roblox** aborda directamente la creciente demanda de contenido orientado a adultos en la plataforma y señala un compromiso con la innovación y el impulso de las barreras creativas. También sugiere que **Roblox** se está posicionando como un serio competidor en el panorama más amplio de los videojuegos, capaz de albergar experiencias que rivalizan con las de consolas y PC tradicionales.

## Próximos Pasos

Estos seis nuevos títulos están actualmente en desarrollo como parte del programa **Roblox Incubator**, con un objetivo de lanzamiento para 2026. Se esperan más detalles sobre **Drifters** y los otros títulos exclusivos para mayores de 18 años a medida que avance el desarrollo.

content_raw: Roblox has pulled back the curtain on a selection of six new 18+ games, including Drifters, an extraction shooter developed by Bungie co-founder Alexander Seropian. Roblox Studio unveiled the new games as part of Roblox Incubator, a six-month program that allows experienced developers to "take promising novel game concepts from prototype to polished games." The 2026 cohort includes 26 teams, with Roblox Studio providing support throughout development, with "additional resources and support" made available as teams reach certain milestones. The six new early-in-development Roblox games look to bring 18-and-older players in the U.S. lots of variety. Although our first look at the projects is limited to short clips and screenshots, it seems each developer is promising truly fleshed-out experiences all within the Roblox platform. Drifters may be the clearest example of that. As Bungie finds its footing with its own extraction shooter take with Marathon, Seropian, who now serves as founder and CEO of Look North World, has his own ideas. Look North World features talent from Bungie, Disney Interactive, EA, Epic Games, and more, and its first game is said to be set in a "dangerous world full of hostile enemies and even-more-hostile players. "I spent my career trying to zig while others have zagged, always looking for new opportunities to learn and grow as a game developer, and my journey on Roblox so far has been the most exciting and personally rewarding since my early days making games on the PC," Seropian said. "There’s just such an energy around the audience growth, tools, and opportunities on this brand-new (to me) platform, and I think it represents a really important part of Interactive’s future. "We’ve decided to build our game here on Roblox to reach this new gaming audience. And we’ve been pleasantly surprised by the quality and depth of the tools and energy that support our craft of making the best games we can." Cosmic Carnage, on the other hand, falls into the car combat genre. Sold as almost a Twisted Metal-like action game, developer Ghost Fox Games says its goal is to bring true destruction derby gameplay to Roblox players. Talent backing the project includes developers from EA, Unity, Disney, and more. Developer Nibblebyte is creating Fossil Force, another extraction shooter that plops players into the Mesozoic Era to fight off dinosaurs. It promises to further explore experiences the team dived into with its Be Dino dinosaur simulation game, but with a bit more bite. Roblox players hoping to get lost in a new universe can look forward to Pixel Blaze Studio's Aetherfall. An open-world, progression-driven RPG, the game promises to let players loose in a world shaped by an event that introduced inhabitants to elemental powers. Pixel Count is creating Sky Pixel, a 2D action-adventure RPG that lets players build, automate, and expand on floating islands.
